justification: LIS2DW12 SDO/SA0 is strapped to V3V3_AON to select I2C address 0x19; in I2C mode it is an address input, not a driver (DS11811 §6). Its internal pull-up cannot be disabled, so strapping low would waste current.

TPS22917 QOD tied to VOUT on purpose (HD-028): SLVSDW8B 8.3.3 uses QOD to VOUT for the on-chip quick discharge. QOD is the drain of the discharge FET, only on while the switch is off, so it never fights the VOUT driver.
